title: Safety Paradox: How Enhanced Safety Awareness Leaves LLMs Vulnerable to Posterior Attack
reasoning: The paper investigates AI safety alignment and jailbreaking vulnerabilities. While it utilizes datasets like AdvBench and HarmBench which categorize 'harmful behavior' (often overlapping with ethical/moral violations), the research focus is on the technical security vulnerability of the models rather than a study or evaluation of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves.
